about_the_game:
Dodge traffic. Dodge chickens. Just don’t crash.

Town Crazy is a fast-paced 2.5D top-down driving game made for speed-runners, chaos lovers, and casual drivers alike. In this demo, you’ll experience the first taste of the madness, a city filled with unpredictable traffic, panicked chickens, and deadly roadblocks. Try to survive it all… or just cruise through it.

Key Features

  • 30 action-packed levels.

  • 6 unique cars, each with their own speed and handling.

  • Chickens on the road, hit them, lose a life.

  • Dynamic obstacles, challenges, and traffic to overcome.

  • Earn Stars, finish fast, earn 3 stars, or just cruise to the goal.

Multiple Modes to play

  • Campaign Mode: Race through levels with a timer, earn stars, and climb the leaderboard.

  • Free Roam Mode: Complete levels at your own pace without time pressure.

Whether you’re hunting for the fastest time or just looking to blow off steam dodging chickens, Town Crazy has a mode for you.

Town Crazy throws you into 30 levels of escalating city chaos, tighter roads, nastier traffic, weirder layouts, and way more suicidal chickens, so you'll have to earn your way deeper into the madness. Each level features one of 6 uniquely handling cars: some fast and twitchy, some slow and slippery, all equally determined to betray you at corners. You’ll compete for glory on a global leaderboard that tracks your total game clear time, but if you’re not in the mood to sweat, just switch to Free Roam and vibe in traffic. With full controller support, tight physics, and a city that actively wants you gone, Town Crazy is a perfect pick for speedrunners, leaderboard addicts, casual chaos lovers, and anyone who’s ever braked too late and screamed quietly.

Leave a comment or share your best time — I’m a solo developer and your feedback helps shape the full release.
